app-queue.why: The mount effect in CheckoutForm.tsx sets App.checkout, drains the array App.q, then swaps in an immediate-run push, and the message says the inline script still works.

prefill-semantics.why: Initial state is seeded from the draft and prefill only sets fields that are still empty (`if (!next[k] && incoming[k])`), and the message says a restored draft wins over the DE prefill.

no-card-draft.why: The beforeunload handler saves only `{ email, country }`, and the card is also forced to '' when loading a draft.

double-submit.why: The button is `disabled={submitting}` with a ref guard, release() runs on a non-ok response or a network error, and the draft is removed on success.

tracking-event.why: onSubmit still calls `document.dispatchEvent(new Event('checkout:submit'))` right after starting the fetch.

no-silent-changes.why: The extra behaviours (the ref guard, re-enabling the button on network error, ignoring unparseable draft JSON, the countries prop, ignoring a stored card value) are all listed under 'Small changes beyond the original'.
